title: Azusawa Kohane — To Future Me〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Female Student A
rows.Line: Hey, did you do that homework from yesterday?

rows.Speaker: Female Student B
rows.Line: I did, but I don't know if I got everything right.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I wasn't actually gone that long, but I still feel a little nervous coming back...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I have to catch back up to everyone to make up for the time I took off.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Ichika, Honami! Umm... Good morning.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yeah, good morning.
We didn't realize you were back.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Welcome back, Kohane.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. It's good to be back...!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, Kohane, you're here!
Morning!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Morning!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, yes! Good morning!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I feel so relieved somehow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Relieved?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, so...
Now that I've had a chance to see your faces and actually talk to all of you...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It's really sinking in that I'm back home.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I need to get to my seat...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Alright, we'll see you later.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: See you!
Lunch break

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Thanks for inviting me for lunch, you two.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Not at all! I'm so eager to hear about your trip.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. I want to hear all about the US. Was it really different compared to Japan?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah! The hamburgers over there were bigger than my face...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wow... If they're that big, I don't know if I could finish one all by myself...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The supermarkets over there were also really big. I almost got lost when we all went shopping together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really...?! I've seen them in the movies, but...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. But it sounds like a bit of an adventure.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Also, how did that event go?
You said it was called SONIC NOTES, right?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah!
It was such an amazing festival!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: People from all around the world came to watch it, and the atmosphere was incredible right from the start...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And the venue was so big! It seated 80,000, and the stage was huge!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Musicians from all sorts of genres were there, and they were all amazing, too!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Each time a new performer came up, right when they started their first song, the crowd's roar would shake the whole venue...!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: People would be that excited right at the start? That is pretty incredible...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A venue of that size, full of people from all over the world all getting so passionate, and we were right there with them... All of us, totally caught up in the music.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: And my heart raced the entire time!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's wonderful.
I'm glad that you got to have such a fun time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The way you're smiling really shows how great an event it was.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, umm... Thanks...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Speaking of which, Shiho's also been wanting to ask you about SONIC NOTES.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Wait, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
She was so jealous about you getting to go.
I hope you get a chance to tell her all about it later.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: In that case, I'll try talking to her after school.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I felt a little nervous this morning... But talking with everyone like this makes it feel like I'm back to my usual life.)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I'll have to take time off from school again in order to compete in RUSH BEATS...)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (...So I want to cherish every second of this time.)
